decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes powerful cards like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for additional threats. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and counter magic like Stubborn Denial to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Tribal Flames is used as a versatile finisher, while Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help stabilize the board. Additionally, the mana base is designed to ensure consistent and efficient casting of spells.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Territorial Kavu, and Scion of Draco to deal damage early and often. It utilizes powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to keep up the pressure and finish off opponents. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to protect your creatures and maintain board control. The deck also includes some card draw and counter spells to provide some flexibility and defense. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and relentless assault.

This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, backed up by powerful finishers like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help protect your creatures and provide additional synergies with the deck's strategy. Overall, this deck focuses on quickly building a threatening board presence and applying constant pressure on your opponent.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast the powerful Primeval Titan and utilize its abilities to tutor for key lands such as Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures. By taking advantage of the Amulet of Vigor, the player can untap lands multiple times and generate large amounts of mana to cast game-ending spells like Scapeshift. The deck also includes various utility lands to provide flexibility and resilience against disruption.Overall, the deck aims to assemble powerful land combinations quickly to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet of Vigor with bounce lands to generate extra mana and play powerful threats like Primeval Titan early in the game. By utilizing cards like Explore and Scapeshift, the deck aims to ramp up quickly and search for key lands such as Urza's Saga. The goal is to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and multiple land drops in a single turn. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Vesuva to provide additional support and protection for its game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on generating early aggression and overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and direct damage. By using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to provide resilience and additional threats. With a mix of aggressive creatures, burn spells, and control elements like Static Prison, the deck looks to maintain pressure and finish the game quickly.

This deck aims to control the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Subtlety. By constantly denying the opponent's threats and disrupting their game plan, the deck looks to outvalue and outlast the opponent until it can close out the game with its powerful creatures. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility, allowing the deck to operate smoothly and efficiently. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to dominate the game through careful resource management and control of the battlefield.

The main focus of this deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent, utilizing burn spells and direct damage spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy, preventing them from stabilizing or mounting a defense. The inclusion of Ensnaring Bridge provides additional protection by preventing the opponent from attacking. This deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible by maintaining a high tempo and constantly applying pressure to the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be blinked or flickered to gain value by reusing their enters the battlefield abilities. The deck includes cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to repeatedly blink creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Emperor of Bones. The strategy also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus to control the opponent's resources. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats. By ramping into high-cost Eldrazi like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Kozilek's Command and Ugin, Eye of the Storms, the deck aims to dominate the battlefield and dictate the pace of the game. The inclusion of control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Sire of Seven Deaths helps maintain board control and ensure victory through sheer power and strategy.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures to control the game and ramp into powerful threats. It utilizes cards like Through the Breach and Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine to cheat out big creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. Torpor Orb and Kozilek's Return help to disrupt opponents, while cards like Nulldrifter provide card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its large Eldrazi threats and control the game until it can close out with a powerful finisher. With a mix of control and ramp elements, the deck seeks to outvalue and outpace opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 setting.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Emrakul, the Promised End. The control aspect of the deck comes from cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to deal with opposing threats, while Karn, the Great Creator can shut down artifact-based strategies. The deck also includes utility lands like Cavern of Souls and Ghost Quarter to help ensure the Eldrazi creatures can be cast and protect the player's game plan.

The deck revolves around quickly and efficiently reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. By combining these reanimation spells with creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck can create explosive combos and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful creatures. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Psychic Frog to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to deal with the constant threat of instant reanimation.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Jeskai Ascendancy to create a powerful combo that allows for fast and explosive turns. The deck is designed to quickly ramp up mana production through Mox Amber and Mox Opal, while using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage and filtering. By utilizing the combo potential of Jeskai Ascendancy and a variety of artifacts, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory with a powerful finish.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be brought back into play multiple times with the help of blink effects like Ephemerate. By utilizing creatures with strong enters-the-battlefield abilities, such as Solitude and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with rapid and repeated creature removal and disruption. Aether Vial allows for instant-speed creature deployment, while cards like Flickerwisp and Witch Enchanter provide additional control options. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and maintain tempo through constant creature recursion and disruption.

The deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures quickly that can be temporarily removed from the battlefield and then brought back for additional value using flicker effects. It combines aggression with blinking abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board presence. The deck utilizes a mix of creatures with powerful abilities that can be repeated with flickering effects, along with removal spells to control the opponent's board. By repeatedly blinking key creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through consistent pressure and value generation.

This deck focuses on utilizing Song of Creation as the engine to draw cards and play spells for free, potentially leading to a game-winning combo with cards like Grapeshot and Jace, Wielder of Mysteries. It includes various cheap artifacts to generate mana and trigger Song of Creation, as well as ways to recur key spells such as Noxious Revival. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells, taking advantage of Song of Creation's powerful card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Utilizing cheap instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to control the board and provide reach to close out the game. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage and find the necessary threats. The goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent and quickly overwhelm them with a mix of creatures and burn spells.

The key strategy of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by instant damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. Mishra's Bauble and Preordain are included to ensure card advantage and card selection, while Slickshot Show-Off and Violent Urge provide additional ways to buff creatures and deal extra damage. The mana base is streamlined with fetch lands to consistently cast spells and maintain pressure on the opponent, ultimately aiming to win the game as quickly as possible.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to deal damage quickly. It also includes several cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to remove opposing threats and clear the way for attacks. Mishra's Bauble helps to filter draws and generate card advantage, while cards like Mutagenic Growth and Monstrous Rage give a temporary boost to creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient assault, utilizing the blue and red color combination for maximum aggression.
